sources.title: nyaaorick/Qwen3.8-2B-q4f16_1-MLC · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-2B-Distill — MLC / WebGPU (q4f16_1) An MLC compilation of empero-ai/Qwen3.8-2B-Distill for WebGPU in the browser, quantized to q4f16_1. Text path only: the vision tower and the MTP head are stripped, since neither is used on the WebGPU path. 632 tensors → 320, 1,881,825,088 parameters, 1.06 GB at 4.503 bits/param.
